title: Canonical affine realization of coinduced polynomial duality models
statement: For a polynomial chart [def-trf-polynomial-duality-restriction-atlas], an affine presentation $\operatorname{Spec}A\to\operatorname{Spec}B$ identified with its closed immersion, and a $B$-module $L$ whose sheaf realizes the top relative differential line, define the canonical map from the sheafification of $R\operatorname{Hom}_B(A,L[n])$ with its $A$-action [def-trf-derived-coinduction] to the geometric coinduction model [def-trf-polynomial-duality-presentation-data]. Use the actual exact associated-sheaf functor and tilde/Gamma adjunction [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction]. The ordinary restriction/pushforward comparison is constrained by the actual adjunction unit and the identity-on-elements affine global-sections comparison [lem-weil-pbc-pushforward-spec-global-sections]; its derived comparison is constrained on every homotopy complex by the original right-derived units [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]. Transport through chart isomorphisms using the original-unit direct-image composition [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image-composition]. The model arrow is the sheaf-coinduction adjunct of the actual module-coinduction counit followed by this coefficient realization. Exactness and composite additivity are proof data; no dualizing object or its identification enters the arrow. Also define the coefficient-volume normalization for full polynomial charts and the canonical source-restriction unit used in the affine compatibility square. The shared canonical primitives are those of [def-trf-polynomial-duality-affine-realization].
